text:
Nadia Russo: Quick heads-up  People Ops drafted two small templates and a peer-feedback flow to slot into the OKR + self-review pack. Link (internal): https://redwood.docs.internal/people/okr-peer-feedback-v1. Could folks skim?
Jamal Carter: Thanks Nadia. What are we calling 'peer feedback' vs 'manager feedback'?
Nadia Russo: Peer feedback is short, evidence-focused, and optional. Manager feedback stays the same. Peer gives 12 quick bullets: what worked, one thing to improve, example link. It helps calibration and raises overlooked collaboration work.
Priya Shah: Love that. Can we have a lightweight anonymous option for peers? Some folks won't give candid notes otherwise.
Nadia Russo: Yes  anonymous by default, aggregated to managers. We only surface direct quotes if the sender opts in. Privacy note added in doc.
Jamal Carter: Nice. Any examples for engineer KRs that are typically hard to measure?
Nadia Russo: Added 6 examples in the appendix. Short excerpt:
```
Obj: Improve inference runtime reliability
KR1: Reduce 99th percentile latency on /v1/generate by 20%
KR2: Cut error budget consumption for top-5 routes by 30%
KR3: Ship 3 automations that remove manual rollback steps
```
Kara Lee: For late hires joining mid-cycle, do we force them to inherit team OKRs or make ramp goals?
Nadia Russo: We added a 30/60/90 ramp template. HiringOps-bot will auto-create a tailored goal set for hires whose start date is after cycle start and send a "mid-cycle ramp" checklist to their manager.
HiringOps-bot: Auto-note: For start dates within 45 days of cycle end, use the 30-day probation template; exceptions can be requested via hiring-ops@redwood.com.
Priya Shah: One more ask  can we include a quick prompt for benefits/time-off impact (e.g., if parental leave overlaps a review period)? Folks should know how partial-cycle leaves affect expectations.
Nadia Russo: Good call. Added an FAQ line: "If >4 weeks paid leave during cycle, manager and employee should set time-boxed delivery expectations; People Ops can flag for adjusted calibration"
Kara Lee: Workshop? I think a 30-min tactical session on writing concise peer notes would help. Many teams abuse the "feedback: good job" pattern.
Nadia Russo: Agreed. Scheduling a 30-min drop-in: "How to write useful peer feedback" on 2026-04-09 09:00 UTC. Invite to follow.
Jamal Carter: Anything automated in the form? I like pre-filled evidence fields (PRs, dashboards) pulled from GitHub/Jira.
Nadia Russo: We added an optional integration field where employees can paste links; in future we'll experiment with auto-suggest. For now it's manual.
Priya Shah: Timeline reminder?
HiringOps-bot: Reminder: OKR + self-review submissions open 2026-04-01 and close 2026-04-17 23:59 UTC. Peer feedback window opens 2026-04-05.
Nadia Russo: Thanks all  please DM any edit suggestions or open a PR on the doc. :handshake:
